requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker may originate BGP routes by injecting routing
   information acquired by some other means (e.g., via an IGP) into BGP.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker originates routes from routing information acquired outside BGP, such as via an IGP.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker may inject that routing information into BGP to originate BGP routes.
requirements.why_checkable: Route origination logic can be checked for the permitted injection of externally acquired routing information.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker that originates BGP routes assigns the degree of
   preference (e.g., according to local configuration) to these routes
   by passing them through the Decision Process (see Section 9.1).
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker originates BGP routes.
requirements.required_behavior: Assign a degree of preference to the originated routes by passing them through the Decision Process.
requirements.why_checkable: The origination path can be inspected to confirm that originated routes pass through the Decision Process and receive a degree of preference.

requirements.quote:
These routes MAY also be distributed to other BGP speakers within the
   local AS as part of the update process (see Section 9.2).
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker has originated routes from non-BGP routing information.
requirements.required_behavior: The originated routes MAY be distributed to other BGP speakers within the local AS as part of the update process.
requirements.why_checkable: Update generation can be checked for the permitted advertisement of locally originated non-BGP routes to speakers in the local AS.

requirements.quote:
The
   decision of whether to distribute non-BGP acquired routes within an
   AS via BGP depends on the environment within the AS (e.g., type of
   IGP) and SHOULD be controlled via configuration.
requirements.condition: Deciding whether to distribute non-BGP acquired routes within an AS via BGP.
requirements.required_behavior: The distribution decision SHOULD be controlled via configuration.
requirements.why_checkable: Configuration controls and their effect on distributing non-BGP acquired routes within the AS can be inspected and exercised.
